## CELL FACTS

Cell 土_正印 (Earth carrying The Sage). Persona The Sage (正印). Definition line: "Nourishment that deepens without redirecting, the root that holds". Keyword Care, charge gentle, poles catalyst Wisdom / friction Comfort. Family function: Mind. Cost dimension: the root that holds; shelter that can become stillness. Arena: roots, old trees, the deep well, inherited warmth. Classical portrait: shelter and nourishment that deepens without redirecting; over-protection, "not ready yet" as a place to stay. Ruled domains: Knowledge, Shelter, Nurture. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 偏印.
Element arena: Earth (ground, soil, load, field, bedrock, harvest). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Metal. structural_interaction seed: "Earth generating Metal cross-polarity — stability nourishing precision and opening direction".
- k2_overview: "Your Earth moves as the Sage: mother ground, nurture in its home element, doubled. You hold people the way land holds houses, unconditionally, for generations, without once mentioning the load. Wisdom settles in you and stays. The whole village builds on your patience. Somewhere in the acreage, keep a field that feeds only you."
- k2_functional: "You think in generational wisdom: what held the family, what will hold it next."
- adj_chips: {"friction":["Closed-off","Buried","Unmoving"],"catalyst":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Knowledge":"Your knowledge is settled sediment: practical wisdom layered by years, the kind villages consult. You know what actually works. Write the almanac down. Ground should not be the only copy.","Shelter":"Your shelter is the family land itself: people return to you between every attempt at the world. Being home is holy work with no clock. Post seasons. Even land lies fallow.","Nurture":"The nourishing thread is bedrock here. Where care came early, you draw on it without thinking. Where it was missing, you became the ground yourself. Keep one plot for you."}

You do not sample, you absorb, and what you absorb becomes permanent equipment. Understanding, for you, is not a pass through the material. It is ownership."

Core element Metal, energy element Earth. Law: Earth feeds Metal (土生金: ore grows in the mountain). Relative to the core the energy is the feeder, so Earth is this core's Mind. No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Metal core that shows Earth on the catalyst pole, so no percentage and no state of one chart appears in any value. The catalyst pole of Earth as the Mind is the Underfueled band's case (the core burns more than it takes in); tone by pole: compliment. value.text: Your presence does the settling long before your words do. Since you need the people near you safe more than impressed, you ask the slow question ahead of the fast fix. Let someone be the steady one for you from time to time, because you need holding as much as everyone you steady.

value_b.text: You give steadiness more freely than you ever ask for it. Keeping the people you love steady is what makes you feel useful, so you play the calm one rather than the one being calmed. Try handing that part over for an evening, because the calm you give is calm you also need.

value.text: Whenever someone close to you comes apart, you turn into the floor under them. You keep them steady rather than get steadied, so you never let them see you shake. Let them watch you wobble sometimes, because you leave the people you hold up no chance to hold you back.

value.text: Trusting what has held comes easier to you than trusting what is new. Because you need an answer to have lasted before leaning on it, you reach for the tested way ahead of the clever one. Give a new idea one honest try each season, since every old answer you trust was new once too.

value_b.text: You keep the answers that have been paid for and shelve the rest. Knowing what has held matters to you ahead of knowing what is current, which is why you change your mind slowly. Let one newer answer onto the shelf each year, since you paid for the kept ones in chances you never took.

value.text: Where someone else would lose patience, you explain it a third time in a third way. Because you need the person in front of you to get there, you give your time ahead of your answer. Keep one hour a week that teaches nobody anything, since patience is a store only you refill.

value_b.text: You explain things at the pace the other person can take them in. Because their understanding comes ahead of your being quick, you say it again rather than say it louder. Let someone teach you something slowly once in a while, since the patience you give is patience you are also owed.

value.text: Giving someone your time is easy for you and hard to count. Since you wait for them to get it rather than hurry them, you hand the evening you kept for yourself to the lesson. Keep one evening no one can borrow, because the patience you spend comes out of a store only rest fills.

value.text: Your patience is something the people you teach learn to count on. You explain it once more instead of watching them struggle, so you take the struggle that would have made it theirs. Let them sit in not knowing longer, since each answer you hand over is practice you keep from them.
